## Caption
Was not sure why I did this video last year in Vietnam…
But this is really me… re-starting myself again from 0 on a new level.

Being born in a small city… I’m the end of Communism regime, would never believe I would be where I’m now.

Never had it easy…
But now I’m so thankful that I never had 
- a privilege passport 
- perfect English 
- rich husband 

And if put all my experiences together I’ve been living 5 lives
Growing up in a Small city, moved to capital at 20, moved to India at 30, moved to Dubai at 34, started my own business at 40.
And Now I feel I’m back to 0 on another level.
Building my media and coaching Empire….
Wringing it  now - and it feel unreal - voice inside my head keeps “saying - whom do you think you are?! Who will listen to you?!”

But the Good thing is - I’ve heard it so many times already - for my this “impostor voice” is just the evidence - I’m on a right track.

And if you hearing it as well sometimes - that Great! You are moving forward!

Happy birthday to me!
